$comment: Single source of truth for child-agent LLMs. Skills substitute {{ALLOWED_MODELS}} with these provider/model pairs at run time; supervisor.py validates RUN.json agents against them. Order is priority: top-down, first choice first, last entry is the fallback. 'use' is the role hint per model. A pair only works if the host also allows it in subagent-model-selection-settings.allowedModels. Edit this file to reconfigure - no code changes.

models.use: free lane, first choice: bounded research, risk checks, mechanical verification, routine coding, tests and docs
official lane, second choice: review, acceptance, difficult debugging when the free lane is rate-limited
subscription fallback, last resort: architecture, complex code, independent second-opinion review
